verdict.rationale: Flagright is a SaaS AML/compliance platform that markets AI agents, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a data-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or controls over AI model training on customer data. The AI-related items (AI agents, MCP server, llms.txt) are about other capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
